decode_uri
Description
Decodes the specified string using HTTP URI encoding per RFC2616 and
returns the result. This is a BIG-IP 4.x variable, provided for
backward-compatibiliy. You can use the equivalent 9.X commmand
URI::decode
instead.
Syntax
decode_uri
<
string
>
decode_uri <string>
Decodes the specified string using HTTP URI encoding per RFC2616 and
returns the result.
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
,
UTILITY_COMMAND
